In addition, LBMA officials foresee platinum prices climbing to $1,914 an ounce and palladium rising to $1,415. This outlook occurs against a backdrop of rising interest rate worries and geopolitical strains that continue to shape the market landscape.

title: US EIA lifts Brent forecast to $98 as Iran war tightens global supplies

Global benchmark Brent crude is expected to average approximately $98 a barrel in 2026. Retail diesel prices are projected to remain high initially before gradually declining to around $4.50 in 2027. Improvements in Middle Eastern oil production are anticipated as transit routes become safer and more efficient.

title: Fed plans bank-supervision overhaul to strengthen accountability, says Vice Chair Michelle Bowman

Five new geographic supervisory regions will be established, each led by a regional leader. This new structure aims to address concerns raised in an independent review of Silicon Valley Bank’s collapse. The Fed will also reconsider asset thresholds for regulatory requirements to better align with inflation and economic growth.
